An authorized distributor/dealer/agent of the OEM/Original Manufacturer. Where the bidder is not the OE M/Original Manufacturer, a valid authorization certificate issued by the OEM/Original Manufacturer shall be submitted along with the bid, wherever applicable. 4. One Bid per Bidder Each bidder shall submit only one bid against this tender. Submission of multiple bids by the same bidder, either directly or indirectly, may result in disqualification in accordance with the applicable GeM terms and conditions. 5. Inspection and Testing ICMR-NITVAR or its designated representative reserves the right to inspect and/or test the supplied Reage nts, wherever considered necessary, to verify conformity with the prescribed specifications, quality require ments, quantity, batch/lot details, shelf life and other contractual requirements. The supplier shall provide all necessary assistance and relevant documentation required for such inspectio n and/or testing. 7. Acceptance of Supplies The supplied Reagents shall be subject to inspection and verification upon receipt at ICMR-NITVAR.

Acceptance shall be accorded only after verification of the quantity, specifications, quality, packaging, bat ch/lot details, expiry date/residual shelf life and other prescribed requirements. Any material found to be damaged, defective, expired, short-supplied, incorrectly supplied or otherwise no t conforming to the prescribed specifications shall be liable for rejection and replacement by the supplier a t no additional cost to ICMR-NITVAR. 8. Packing and Transportation The Reagents shall be suitably packed to protect them from damage, contamination, deterioration, moistu re, temperature variation and other risks during handling, transportation and storage. The supplier shall ensure that the packaging complies with applicable statutory, regulatory and manufactu rer requirements. The material shall be delivered to the consignee location specified in the GeM Contract. Where the nature of the consumables requires specific transportation or storage conditions, the supplier sh all ensure compliance with such conditions throughout transportation and delivery. 9. Replacement of Defective/Damaged Material Any reagent found to be defective, damaged, contaminated, deteriorated, expired, short-supplied or other wise not conforming to the prescribed specifications shall be replaced by the supplier at no additional cost to ICMR-NITVAR. The replacement shall be made within the period specified by ICMR-NITVAR. 10. Payment Terms 100% payment shall be released after successful delivery, inspection and acceptance of the reagents by I CMR-NITVAR and submission of all required documents, subject to applicable statutory deductions. The following documents shall be submitted for processing of payment, as applicable: a. Copy of the Purchase Order/GeM Contract; b. Tax Invoice; c. Delivery Challan/Consignee Receipt; d. Inspection/Acceptance Certificate, wherever applicable; and e. Any other document required under the GeM Bid/Contract. 11. Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) Performance Bank Guarantee shall be applicable as per the terms and conditions specified in the GeM Bid/ Contract and applicable Government rules. 12. Liquidated Damages In the event of delay in delivery attributable to the supplier, Liquidated Damages shall be levied in accord ance with the provisions of the applicable GeM Contract, subject to the maximum permissible limit prescrib ed therein. 13. GST and Other Taxes GST and all other applicable taxes, duties, levies and statutory charges shall be governed by the prevailing Government of India rules and regulations. Unless specifically provided otherwise in the GeM Bid, the rates quoted by the bidder shall be inclusive of all applicable charges up to the consignee location. 14. Blacklisted/Debarred Firms Bidders who, as on the date of bid submission, are blacklisted, debarred, suspended or otherwise prohibite d from participating in procurement by any Government organisation or through the GeM Portal shall be in eligible to participate in this GeM Bid. The bidder shall comply with all applicable declarations and requirements prescribed under the GeM terms

and conditions in this regard. 15. Delivery The complete quantity of consumables shall be delivered to the following consignee location: ICMR–National Institute of Translational Virology and AIDS Research (NITVAR), Pune, Maharashtra. The complete supply shall be delivered within the delivery period specified in the GeM Contract. 16. Make in India (MII) Policy The bidder shall comply with the applicable provisions of the Government of India Make in India (MII) Policy and other applicable Government procurement policies, as amended from time to time. 17. Technical Compliance and Documents The bidder shall submit the following documents along with the bid: a. Point-wise compliance against each specification mentioned in the attached Specification Document; b. Product catalogue/brochure/data sheet, wherever applicable; c. OEM/Manufacturer Authorisation Certificate, wherever applicable; d. Details of make, model, product code/catalogue number, wherever applicable; and e. Any other supporting technical literature or document specifically required under the bid. Failure to submit the required technical documents may result in the bid being considered non-responsive, subject to the applicable GeM provisions. 18. Discrepancy Between GeM Bid and Specification Document In the event of any discrepancy, inconsistency or conflict between the specifications mentioned in the GeM Bid and those specified in the Specification Document attached under the Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC, t he provisions of the Specification Document shall prevail, to the extent permissible under the applicable G eM terms and conditions and Government rules. 19. The complete quantity shall be considered as one procurement requirement and shall be supplied in accordance with the GeM Contract, subject to the applic able GeM provisions. 20. In the event that the dispute cannot be resolved amicably, it shall be dealt with in accordance with the app licable contractual provisions, GeM terms and conditions and applicable laws of India. The jurisdiction for arbitration and/or legal proceedings, to the extent permissible under the applicable con tractual provisions, shall be Pune, Maharashtra. 21. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days.
